path.roadSpeedLimitHelp: Leave blank to follow the city speed limit. Changes are applied automatically after a short pause.

topology.mergeHint: Click the path to merge with in the 3D view. Only paths of the same type that share an endpoint with no other path attached can be selected.
topology.splitHint: Click the point to split at in the 3D view. The split point is placed on the path centerline.
topology.waitingSelection: Waiting for a selection in the 3D view.

path.pendingWarning: This road is planned. Please command to start construction.

constructionShortage.title: Construction Service Shortage
constructionShortage.description: Construction budget is insufficient, causing delays in construction.

accident.title: Traffic Accident!
accident.description: A traffic accident has occurred on the road.

noStationHouse.title: No Station Building
noStationHouse.description: This platform does not belong to any station. Draw a station building line across it from the Station Building tab of the Track Construction panel.

path_construction.validationMaxSpan: The distance between nodes {{start}}–{{end}} is {{distance}}m, exceeding the {{limit}}m limit. Add an intermediate node or shorten the span.
path_construction.validationCurve: Path {{track}}: curve radius is below the minimum from {{start}} to {{end}} m from the start.
path_construction.validationGrade: Path {{track}}: grade exceeds the maximum from {{start}} to {{end}} m from the start.
path_construction.validationPathCollision: Road or track occupancy overlaps. Check the red occupancy volumes.
path_construction.validationRiverCollision: The path crosses a river at ground level. Adjust the elevation or route.
path_construction.validationGradingSite: A path cannot pass through an earthworks site, even elevated or underground. Keep clear of the site until the work is finished.
path_construction.validationRejected: Construction requirements are not met. Check the shape and settings.
path_construction.validationUnavailable: Cannot validate construction without a server connection setting.
path_construction.shapeUnready: Right-click in the 3D view to finalize the shape.
path_construction.collisionUnready: Finalize the shape and resolve any collisions shown by red volumes.
path_construction.alignmentUnready: A curve or grade exceeds the limits of this standard. Ease the alignment.
path_construction.followTerrainHelp: When set to No Follow, sections crossing hills automatically become cuts/tunnels and sections spanning valleys become bridges.
path_construction.confirmFailedUnknown: Failed to confirm the path. Please modify the shape and try again.
path_construction.costRatioHelp: Building roads on elevated or underground structures, or over complex terrain, increases the construction cost.
path_construction.placedContinue: Path placed. Place the next path.
path_construction.stationHouseHint: Draw the station building line. Platforms crossed by the line belong to this station. Buildings are placed at both ends of the line, connected by an overhead bridge. Station buildings never snap to existing roads or tracks (only grid snapping applies).

rail.builtInDoubleTrack: This track represents both directions (double track) with a single path. Trains run both ways on it, so the number of tracks, direction and spacing cannot be set.

road.title: Road
road.newNote: When you confirm, a new road is created from the sections you build.
road.createFailed: The sections were built, but the new road could not be created.

path_shape_editor.hintPlacing: Right-click in the 3D view to finalize the shape, then edit it here
path_shape_editor.hintEditing: Drag: move node/handle  Click edge: add node  Right-click: delete node
path_shape_editor.profileHint: Drag a node up/down to change its height (no horizontal movement)
path_shape_editor.profileReadOnly: Finalize the shape in the 3D view to edit heights
